a.text: What are we doing, you ask? Hah, what else can we warriors of Acahualla do?
The greatest weapons, the sturdiest buildings. With the High Priest and Inam Committee's support, we can build even more machines!
Conquest! 'Manure factory!' The Acahualla name will ring across all the lands!

steps.name: Agitated Archosauria
steps.text: 'Manure factory.' What a great word... That's how you say it, right, Yogi?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: No, Yota, it's 'manufacturing.' Besides, you should try to get some more rest instead of helping out with work on the... uh... 'Forest Mk. III,' the fully-automatic tree planting and cutting robot.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Actually, since we wrote it off and built a new one last night, this is 'Mk. IV.'

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: I've been doing great lately, don't worry. I never thought these rocks... Uh, the Originium could be so useful. My eyes are wide open now! Is this new technology? Who brought it here?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Probably Inam.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Ah... It's strong like Gavial, and you can shoot the upper half up in a spiral. It even stays midair for half a minute.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Yeah, it's pretty shocking. Though the High Priest calls that 'disassembly.'

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: I've been thinking for a while... Look, the lands beyond are so vast, and now we have so much... 'Manufactoring.'

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Manufacturing. And the High Priest said before that's not how you use the word.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: That doesn't matter. What matters is that we'll have more and more big machines! They'll also get easier to control and cause less accidents, too!

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: There's much more we can do now, isn't there?!

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Like what?

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Be ambitious, Brother. Set your sights on all of Sargon. Can you see it now—

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Uh, uhh...

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: —Our statues! As tall as three mountains and as big as two whole lakes!

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Ooohh—!

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Of course, we need one for the clan leader too... and the High Priest! We can't forget Inam, either...

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Finally, we need something special to celebrate all this... A building! Right! A palace! Let's see... with wood? No, it has to be sandstone or some sturdier rock... Let's use Originium! That's it!

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: We'll pile the Originium up to make a huge building!

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Pile it up? I-Into what? Like a temple?

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Maybe something simpler. Like a circle... Hm, you can't make a circle with rocks. Let's pile it up layer by layer so it looks like a triangle from all directions!

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Oh... Ohh! A triangular tower! Now we just need to give it a name!

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Still... there's no point in talking about all this. Gavial said I won't live that long with my disease.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Yota... No! We just have to change the way we think. Let's turn this palace into your burial plot.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: That way, forget Acahualla, all of Sargon will remember your name. And I know what to call it, too! 'Yogi Yota Tower!' We'll finish it before you die!

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Yogi...!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Don't jinx yourselves like that...

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Oh, Tomimi... What are you doing here?

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: I thought you went straight to Gavial and the clan leader yesterday.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's been a while since I was back home. I can't just leave like that, can I?

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: I guess not. So, what are you doing here today? You already stopped by, didn't you?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Actually...

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Oh, you're the shortie Inam mentioned. What's the matter? Are you here to complain about our food again? Yeah, I've been thinking the food's been kind of bland lately too. How are we supposed to get by without meat?

steps.name: Scathing Durin
steps.text: No, it's something else. And I have a name. Stitch Canvas. You can't judge me by my height. Are all Archosauria like this?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Haha, no, we're not...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Whatever. You're a bunch of weirdos bickering about tail thickness anyway... I guess it's a cultural difference that I'll have to respect.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? Huh...?

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Alright, so what do you need? We're working on a magnificent 'bluepint' for Sargon.

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Blueprint.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Uh, right. Blueprint. You hear that, Durin man? This is a huge, glorious plan!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I kind of think... a big, over-the-top tomb isn't a such a great plan... Besides, if everyone gets a huge tomb like that, we won't have enough room in the rainforest.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Stop calling it a tomb. It's for celebration! It's celebratory!

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: If we build it bigger, we can put both the leader and Gavial in there too, and our descendants will sing the praises of Zumama and 'Gavial's Will' in front of our statues, with their kids all around them.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: (I am starting to regret this decision...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wha...! B-But...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Right. Right now, we shouldn't—

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: —In that case, we can't call it the 'Yogi Yota Tower!' It has to have Gavial's name in it! W-We can add my name in there too, while we're at it...!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Uh, no, I mean... Well, Mr. Stitch already talked to Inam about this, but I want everyone to hear him explain it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: This is pretty serious, after all. I sent Gavial a letter too, but I don't know if they'll make it in time...

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Serious? What's so serious? I'm trying to plan out the rest of my life with what little time I have left! What could be more serious than that?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: *cough*... I'm not here to judge your fantastical ideas, surface dwellers. However...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Just as I said before, if our city actually meets this crisis, the calamity will destroy everything.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: And when that happens, it won't matter how amazing your buildings are. They'll be reduced to rubble.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Zumama.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial? I didn't know we came back at the same time.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: How's the situation? Have those Infected settled down?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Who do you think you're talking to? Not just the Infected. Mine security, the villagers nearby, and that old man from Rim Billiton. I took care of all of them.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Old man...? You dealt with our business partner, too?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, I've got a problem with the way he treats the Infected. I had to have a friendly chat with him, as a doctor. 'From a doctor's perspective and the Gavial way.'

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Never mind all that. Have you seen the letter yet?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I haven't been back to the dorms... It's a letter from Tomimi? She went back home to visit her family, didn't she?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, and she's been keeping in touch with her Acahualla friends through Inam.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looked like she was going to ask us to go with her, too.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: A trip home together... If only Master Closure hadn't given me any work. That would've been nice.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But if that was the whole story, you wouldn't have bothered to come looking for me, right?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey now, when did we become strangers?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Never mind... So, what did Inam say? Did Tomimi run into trouble?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, more accurately, the whole rainforest's in trouble.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Better pack up and get yourself ready. We're in for a big adventure.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: T-The whole rainforest will sink into the earth?! The entire land will shift and change?!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I could explain the structure of a Durin city, but it's not like you would understand. To put it simply, my homeland is under the ground not far from this rainforest.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: We've run into some trouble... and that's why I came up here to seek the surface-dwellers' help.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Now, I didn't actually have very high hopes for you lot to begin with, but I saw what you've been doing. Perhaps you can be of some help.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Well, that does sound like a big problem... but that doesn't have much to do with our tribe, right?

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: Wait, this guy said if the Durin city's destroyed, it'll cause a chain reaction that will affect the surface... and our Yota Yogi Tower will...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: On the flipside, if you help us, we'll return the favor with our Durin technology.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I don't know a lot about your tech level... but I can tell at a glance that your kind can sometimes be outrageously primitive.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Help? From an outsider? Now I'm not so sure we could use any...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Ugh, to me, it's you surface-dwellers who are the outsiders... Never mind.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But Mr. Stitch did point out some serious problems with the 'Forest Mk. III' when he looked at it... although it kinda seems like he got rid of a lot of its functions...

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: This guy did?!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yep, that's why Inam figured we should follow Mr. Stitch underground to see what's going on. I-I'm going too, of course, as the clan leader of 'Gavial's Will.'

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: And while we're gone, it's up to you guys to take care of everyone in Tiacauh.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: Well, I've got problem with that... I mean, for the sake of our Yo... No, our 'Great Gold Originium Pearl Triangular Tower of Great Acahualla,' you better get this problem solved!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: You used the word 'great' twice...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: We will.

steps.name: Yota
steps.text: But how are you going to get there...? We haven't been outside the forest too much. Are you sure you won't get lost?
Don't you worry!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: After all, I am coming along.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mr. E-Elysium!

steps.name: Yogi
steps.text: You're the Rhodes Islander...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Resilient as I am, even I have to take a vacation to alleviate the stress I've accumulated. Little did I know I'd find myself in another tremendous operation to save the Durins... But never mind. Who am I to miss out on more fun?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Dylan and Blaze were right. It's a bustling place, but you can still relax and wind down a little. A wonderful little spot.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I still have yet to find those famously delicious mushrooms after searching through the woods multiple times, though...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I only hope that Miss Inam will follow through on her promise to help me accomplish the 'seven must-dos when visiting Acahualla.'

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mr. Elysium and Mr. Stitch have already gotten the ball rolling. With the two of them as guides, we won't ever lose our way... or at least that's what they promised.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha, perhaps by the time Gavial and Eunectes make it home, we will have already taken care of everything.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: She used to be the impatient one... How come I have to wait half an hour in the hallway for her now?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Look at this new gear... I thought Gavial would file a request for this stuff every month, but I guess that wasn't really the case, judging by Master Closure's reaction.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So I guess she's not going back to playing 'wandering medic who left the tribe'?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: This is taking way too long! Gavial, what are you doing?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Don't rush me! You guys put together the most complicated equipment, you know?!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: This is what you get when you make an order on such short notice! If you have a problem with that, maybe you should go through proper procedures with Engineering next time.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ugh—! This sucks! Not even those knights in Kazimierz wear this much armor!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Doesn't matter, if there's anything you can't figure out—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Forget it! This will do! I'm tossing the rest!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, forget all that junk. Don't need it. The moment I picked up this axe, I figured it all out.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Figured what out...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That this guy's all I need.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Did you make it?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It was a rush order.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I knew it. Only you could make something this kick-ass. No complaints. From the balance to the weight, all perfect.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But this little ornament...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Lancet-2 told me to pour my feelings into everything I contribute to, whether a patient or equipment.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: She said that, huh? Probably learned it from Closure. Well, whatever winds your sprocket.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright then, let's go!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What now, more dawdling?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What... are you going to do? It sounds like the Durins' call for help that Tomimi got might be some kind of crisis their city is facing.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It might be a Catastrophe... It might be war.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: The letter says 'fire rained down from the sky and burned our quilts' and 'a giant mushroom sprouted from the ground and blocked the sunlight, preventing the plants from growing,' but it's all too abstract.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: No matter what the problem is, we oughta be able to tackle it. I mean, Inam and Elysium are coming too.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Tackle it how?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Didn't you just give me the answer? Check out my getup. I really mean it, Zumama. I haven't been this excited in a while.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So you mean you're using your fists again.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah, the usual!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: The usual, huh...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Time waits for no one, Zumama.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Don't you want to see with your own eyes what those guys from your tribe have done to the forest?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hah... I guess so.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Let's get going, then.
